project: 末日尸潮 · 横屏肉鸽射击
note: 角色 roster 唯一真源。画布施工单（canvas 段）由本文件驱动。风格 token 见 assets/style/tokens.json。
styleSuffix: American comic book style zombie game character, thick black ink outlines, bold saturated flat colors, 2-step cel shading, halftone dots in shadows, white clean background, full body, centered, character design turnaround sheet, no text, no UI, no watermark

levelStructure.name: 城郊公路
levelStructure.arena: 加油站雨棚 + 翻覆车阵，开阔但多硬掩体

levelStructure.name: 废弃仓库
levelStructure.arena: 货架巷道 + 冷库，视线被切碎，适合伏击

levelStructure.name: 地铁隧道
levelStructure.arena: 狭长线性，纵向空间高，天花板可挂敌

levelStructure.name: 生化医院
levelStructure.arena: 天台开阔 + 病房迷宫双层，风向影响毒息

npcs.name: 游荡者
npcs.role: 教学兵 · 教玩家侧移绕后与打头
npcs.silhouette: 倒三角躯干 + 双臂垂过膝盖 + 头部低垂
npcs.look: 瘦长驼背，前臂过长垂至膝下，下颚脱臼半垂露出牙齿，破烂加油站连体工装，左小腿胫骨外露，皮肤尸绿带灰斑

attack.name: 挥抓
attack.telegraph: 右臂高举过头顶，地面出现淡红扇形警示

npcs.weakness: 头部 ×2.5 伤害；可被近战击退打断前摇

ai.base: Gaunt shambling zombie, hunched back, unnaturally long forearms hanging past its knees, dislocated jaw hanging half open with exposed teeth, torn gas-station coverall, exposed shin bone on left leg, sickly green-grey skin with ash blotches
ai.front: front facing orthographic view, standing idle, arms hanging low, full body
ai.side: side profile orthographic view, showing hunched spine curve and overhanging jaw, full body
ai.attack: front three-quarter view mid-attack, right arm raised high overhead about to swipe down, motion arc lines, aggressive snarl

npcs.name: 扑跃者
npcs.role: 打断站桩输出 · 逼玩家保留位移
npcs.silhouette: 水平压缩 + 四肢外张 + 前倾头颅
npcs.look: 猫科骨架，脊椎棘突外露成锯齿状背脊，后腿蜷曲呈蓄力态，下颌骨完全缺失、口腔纵向开裂至胸腔，指端生骨刺

attack.name: 扑跃
attack.range: 直线 6 m / 落点 1.6 m AoE
attack.telegraph: 后腿压低、身体贴地，地面亮起黄色直线预警

npcs.weakness: 蓄力 0.5s 内被打断 → 自伤 15 并翻倒 1.2 s

ai.base: Feline-skeleton zombie crouched on all fours, spine spikes protruding in a jagged ridge, coiled hind legs, lower jaw entirely missing so the mouth splits vertically down into the chest cavity, bone spurs on fingertips, dark red flesh
ai.front: front facing orthographic view, crouched coiled stance, symmetric, full body
ai.side: side profile orthographic view, showing the coiled hind leg spring tension and jagged spine ridge, full body
ai.attack: side view mid-leap, body horizontal stretched forward through the air, jaws wide open, speed lines trailing behind

npcs.name: 呕吐者
npcs.role: 占场型 · 逼玩家离开掩体与固定输出位
npcs.silhouette: 巨大球腹 + 萎缩细肢 + 上仰喷口头
npcs.look: 腹部膨大成半透明球，内部毒囊透出绿光，双臂萎缩贴身，头颈后仰、口器呈喇叭状喷口，躯干与四肢比例极端失衡

attack.name: 酸液抛射
attack.range: 9 m 抛物线 / 落点 2 m 毒池持续 4 s
attack.telegraph: 球体鼓胀发亮，落点提前 0.8 s 出现绿圈

npcs.weakness: 击中发光毒囊 → 立即在自身脚下生成毒池，可被引诱自伤

ai.base: Bloated zombie with a huge translucent spherical belly, glowing green toxin sac visible inside, withered atrophied arms pressed tight against the body, head tilted back with a flared trumpet-like nozzle mouth, extreme proportion imbalance
ai.front: front facing orthographic view, standing, huge belly centered, symmetric, full body
ai.side: side profile orthographic view, showing the backward-tilted nozzle head and the belly overhang, full body
ai.attack: front three-quarter view, belly contracted and glowing, mid-vomit arc of green acid spraying forward in a parabolic stream

npcs.name: 盾卫
npcs.role: 教玩家绕侧背 · 正面硬刚必亏
npcs.silhouette: 厚重金属矩形 + 单侧巨大盾板 · 左右强不对称
npcs.look: 钢板直接焊进胸腔与左臂形成一体化盾板，头盔焊死只剩横向观察缝，右臂裸露并畸形肥大，背脊椎接口裸露发红光

attack.name: 盾击冲锋
attack.telegraph: 低头、盾板前压，地面出现黄色冲锋轨迹

npcs.weakness: 正面 120° 减伤 70%；背面脊椎红色接口 ×2 伤害

ai.base: Heavy zombie with steel plates welded directly into its chest and left arm forming a single integrated shield slab, helmet welded shut leaving only a horizontal viewing slit, right arm bare and grotesquely overgrown, exposed red-glowing spinal port on its back, teal weld beads
ai.front: front facing orthographic view, shield slab covering the left side, welded helmet facing viewer, full body
ai.side: side profile orthographic view from the unshielded right side, showing the depth of the shield slab and the exposed back port, full body
ai.attack: front view charging forward low, shield slab leading, head down, impact dust and speed lines

npcs.name: 爆尸
npcs.role: 走位惩罚 + 环境武器（可引爆清群）
npcs.silhouette: 正圆球 + 无脖子 + 最小头身比
npcs.look: 全身充气水肿，皮肤半透可见皮下黄色气肿结节，肚皮裂纹透出橙光，脖子完全消失、头颅陷进躯干，四肢短小

attack.name: 自爆
attack.windup: 1.5 s 引信（进入 2.5 m 触发）
attack.telegraph: 体表由绿转红、裂纹增亮、高频蜂鸣

npcs.weakness: 引信期间击杀 → 伤害减半；可引到尸群中当炸弹用

ai.base: Grossly inflated zombie, whole body swollen like a water balloon, translucent skin revealing subcutaneous yellow gas nodules, cracks across the belly glowing orange from within, neck completely gone with the skull sunk into the torso, tiny stubby limbs
ai.front: front facing orthographic view, perfectly round body, tiny sunken head, symmetric, full body
ai.side: side profile orthographic view, showing the round belly overhang and stubby limbs, full body
ai.attack: front three-quarter view at the moment of detonation trigger, body flushed from green to red, cracks blazing orange, warning pulse rings expanding outward

bosses.name: 屠夫
bosses.silhouette: 宽肩倒梯形 + 右臂单点长垂（肉钩）
bosses.look: 3.2 m 巨型，血污帆布围裙挂满金属挂钩，右臂自肘部截断接上 60 cm 肉钩，左臂改装成缓慢转动的绞肉机滚筒，猪头面具眼孔透黄光，脚踝锁着崩断的铁链

attacks.name: 横扫
attacks.desc: 肉钩 270° 横扫，前摇 0.9 s，半径 4 m，伤害 30 + 击退 3 m
attacks.telegraph: 地面亮起黄色弧形预警，弧长即判定范围

attacks.name: 冲锋
attacks.desc: 直线突进 12 m，伤害 25；撞墙后自我眩晕 2.0 s
attacks.telegraph: 低头蓄力 0.7 s，地面黄色直线轨迹

attacks.name: 抛钩
attacks.desc: 9 m 抛钩命中拉拽玩家强制位移 + 0.8 s 硬直，伤害 10
attacks.telegraph: 链条绷紧声 + 钩子发光 0.5 s

bosses.vulnerable: 撞墙眩晕 2.0 s，期间减伤 -50%
bosses.godViewNote: 俯角 55° 下 270° 横扫必须靠地面预警弧读图，光靠身体动画看不清；撞墙点是唯一的稳定输出窗口，要在场景里放明确的撞墙位

ai.base: Giant 3.2 meter butcher zombie, bloodstained canvas apron hung with metal meat hooks, right arm severed at the elbow and replaced with a 60cm meat hook, left arm replaced with a slowly rotating meat-grinder drum, pig-head mask with glowing yellow eye holes, snapped iron chains locked around the ankles
ai.front: front facing orthographic view, wide trapezoid shoulders, both modified arms visible, full body
ai.side: side profile orthographic view, showing the long hanging meat hook arm and the grinder drum silhouette, full body
ai.attack: front three-quarter view mid-sweep, meat hook arm extended horizontally trailing a bright yellow ground warning arc, apron whipping, impact dust

bosses.name: 母体
bosses.silhouette: 上下双体（地面产卵囊 + 反折上身）+ 双臂拖地
bosses.look: 4.0 m 高，下半身是巨大的产卵囊固定在隧道地面与顶部之间，上半身人形但腰椎反折成 C 形后弓，双臂过长垂地拖行，头颅后仰、口器纵向开裂至胸腔

attacks.name: 产卵
attacks.desc: 每 8 s 从囊袋产出 6 只幼虫（1.1 m / 速度 4.5 / HP 20 / 自爆 8 伤害）

attacks.name: 酸雨
attacks.desc: 天花板 3 段连环 AoE，每段伤害 15

attacks.name: 拍击
attacks.desc: 双臂交替砸地，冲击波沿隧道十字扩散，伤害 22
attacks.telegraph: 单臂高举 0.8 s，地面出现十字裂纹预告

bosses.vulnerable: 产卵时囊袋张开 1.5 s，期间 ×2 伤害
bosses.godViewNote: 本体固定 → 玩家走位空间是环形，必须用地面分区色（安全 / 危险）持续可读；幼虫数量要有 HUD 计数，否则玩家会读不清压力来源

ai.base: Towering 4 meter broodmother zombie, lower half is a massive egg sac anchored between the tunnel floor and ceiling, upper humanoid half with the spine bent backward into a C-curve, unnaturally long arms dragging on the ground, head tilted back with the mouth split vertically down into the chest, purple bioluminescent veins
ai.front: front facing orthographic view, egg sac base below, arching upper body above, both long arms dragging, full body
ai.side: side profile orthographic view, showing the backward C-curve of the spine and the depth of the egg sac, full body
ai.attack: front three-quarter view mid-slam, one long arm raised high about to crash down, egg sac opening glowing and distended, shockwave cracks spreading on the floor

bosses.name: 零号
bosses.silhouette: 瘦高 + 破碎下摆 + 胸腔纵向裂口发光
bosses.look: 2.6 m 瘦削高挑，白大褂撕裂成条状下摆，胸腔纵向裂开露出第二张口器（内衬环状牙齿），头骨左半外露、右半覆盖萎缩皮肤，静脉发紫光，左手拖着断裂的输液架

attacks.name: 100–70% · 注射器飞刀
attacks.desc: 三连射，射程 12 m，伤害 12 / 发；附带 6 m 短距闪现（CD 4 s）
attacks.telegraph: 抬手 +  syringe 尖端紫光 0.4 s

attacks.name: 70–35% · 长鞭双臂
attacks.desc: 撕裂白大褂 → 双臂变异为 7 m 长鞭，横扫 + 拉拽；召唤 3 只盾卫
attacks.telegraph: 白大褂撕裂瞬间 1.2 s 硬直（可打断）

attacks.name: 35–0% · 胸腔毒息
attacks.desc: 第二张口器张开，120° 扇形毒息持续 5 s（DPS 14）+ 全场毒池；狂暴（速度 ×1.6、攻击 CD ×0.7）
attacks.telegraph: 胸腔裂口紫光暴涨 1.0 s

bosses.vulnerable: 每次阶段切换 1.2 s 硬直，可打断一次攻击；P3 毒息期间侧后方为安全区
bosses.godViewNote: 阶段切换靠体态突变读图：P2 手臂变长、P3 胸腔张开——这两个是最强信号，必须做成全屏可辨的轮廓变化，不能只靠血条数字

ai.base: Tall gaunt 2.6 meter patient zero zombie, white lab coat torn into hanging tatters, chest split vertically open revealing a second mouth lined with ringed teeth, left half of the skull exposed bone and right half covered in withered skin, purple glowing veins, dragging a broken IV stand in the left hand
ai.front: front facing orthographic view, tall and thin, chest rift visible and glowing, coat tatters hanging, full body
ai.side: side profile orthographic view, showing the gaunt frame depth and the open chest rift profile, full body
ai.attack: front three-quarter view phase 3, chest rift wide open blazing purple, fan-shaped toxic breath spraying forward, lab coat tatters whipping, one arm mutated into a long lash whip

frames.title: 敌群图鉴 · 投放矩阵
